headerDisplay: Adds ecobee Smart Security to Apple Home: set it to Home, Away or Off, and see alarms. Unofficial. It uses the same ecobee cloud as the ecobee app.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name shown in the Home app.

refreshToken.title: Refresh token
refreshToken.description: Filled in when you sign in. You only need a new one if ecobee signs the plugin out, for example after a password change.

homeId.title: Home ID
homeId.description: Only needed if your ecobee account has more than one home. The settings page lists them.

offerNight.title: Enable Night
offerNight.description: Adds a Night mode to use in automations. ecobee has no Night mode, so Night arms ecobee's Stay. Changing this recreates the security system in the Home app, so you need to set up its scenes and automations again.

alarmTrigger.title: Home app alarm

oneOf.title: When a sensor is tripped (entry delay starts)
When the siren goes off (entry delay ran out)

alarmTrigger.description: Sets when the Home app's security tile shows Triggered. Its critical alert and "security system triggered" automations follow it. ecobee's own alerts and professional monitoring don't change. "When a sensor is tripped" alerts every time someone comes in while it's armed, even if they disarm in time. Smoke alarms always trigger immediately.

smokeSensor.title: Smoke sensor
smokeSensor.description: Adds a Smoke Alarm accessory that detects smoke when ecobee reports a smoke alarm. Use it for Home app notifications and automations.

allowHolds.title: Allow security holds
allowHolds.description: Lets other Homebridge plugins, like a robot vacuum, keep the system from arming Away while they work: if it's armed Away it's switched to Home (ecobee's Stay), and Away comes back when they're done. Away asked for in the Home app meanwhile waits until they're done. Each plugin also has to be allowed in holdPlugins (the settings page lists the ones that asked). See "Security holds" in the README.

holdPlugins.title: Plugins allowed to ask for holds
holdPlugins.description: Package names of the plugins that may ask, or the name a plugin asks with if it gives no package. With no list, all plugins may ask while Allow security holds is on.

armAwayNowSwitch.title: Arm Away Now switch
armAwayNowSwitch.description: Adds an Arm Away Now switch to the Home app (with Allow security holds on). Turning it on arms Away now, with the normal exit delay, and asks any task that's running to stop (a robot goes back to its base, or stops where it is if it can't make it in time). Away from the security tile, scenes, automations and Siri waits until robots are done instead.

taskWaitSeconds.title: Extra time for tasks to finish (seconds)
taskWaitSeconds.description: If Away is armed while a task is running, like a robot heading back to its base, the countdown waits up to this much longer, and arms as soon as it's done. 0: no waiting.

keypadDisarm.title: Disarm when a door is unlocked with its keypad
keypadDisarm.description: Entering a code on a smart lock's keypad turns the security system off, so family and guests can use their lock codes. Works with locks in Apple Home from this Homebridge that report keypad unlocks. Needs Homebridge's insecure mode. See "Keypad unlock" in the README.

keypadLocks.title: Locks that disarm
keypadLocks.description: Serial numbers of the locks that disarm (the settings page lists the ones found). With no list, every lock does.

occupancySwitch.title: Home Occupied switch
occupancySwitch.description: Adds a Home Occupied switch to the Home app, with an occupancy sensor. By default your own people-arrive and people-leave automations set it, and it does the rest: off (nobody home) arms Away, on (someone home) turns Away off. Switches don't ask for confirmation the way automations that change the security system do. See "Home Occupied switch" in the README.

occupancySource.title: Home Occupied source
occupancySource.description: Who sets Home Occupied. Home App Automations: your arrive/leave automations. ecobee Autopilot: the ecobee app's location on household members' phones, which need location set to Always in the ecobee app. ecobee Smart Home & Away: the thermostat decides from motion on ecobee sensors (plus phones when Autopilot is on); it can be slow to notice an empty home, and it doesn't arm or disarm. See "Home Occupied source" in the README.

memberPresence.title: Presence sensors for household members
memberPresence.description: Adds an occupancy sensor for each person in presenceMembers, for Home app conditions like "only if Alex is home". Anyone you share your Home with can see them. Each person's phone needs location set to Always in the ecobee app. See "Member presence sensors" in the README.

presenceMembers.title: People with a presence sensor
presenceMembers.description: ecobee account ids of the people to add (the settings page lists them). With no list, none.

vacationSwitch.title: Vacation Mode switch
vacationSwitch.description: Shows when an ecobee vacation is on, for other accessories to follow. Turn it on to start a vacation now, until you turn it off; set dated vacations in the ecobee app.

vacationWhenEmpty.title: Start a vacation when the home has been empty for
vacationWhenEmpty.description: A safety net if you forget to turn Vacation Mode on: starts an ecobee vacation once Home Occupied has been off for vacationEmptyHours. Needs the Home Occupied and Vacation Mode switches, and a Home Occupied source other than ecobee Smart Home & Away.

condition.functionBody: return model.vacationSwitch === true && model.occupancySwitch === true && model.occupancySource !== 'ecobee';

vacationEmptyHours.title: Hours empty before the vacation starts
vacationEmptyHours.description: How long the home has to be empty first.

condition.functionBody: return model.vacationWhenEmpty === true && model.vacationSwitch === true && model.occupancySwitch === true && model.occupancySource !== 'ecobee';

vacationEndOnArrival.title: End the vacation when someone comes home
vacationEndOnArrival.description: Ends any running ecobee vacation, including dated ones from the ecobee app, when Home Occupied turns on. Needs the Home Occupied and Vacation Mode switches, and a Home Occupied source other than ecobee Smart Home & Away.

condition.functionBody: return model.vacationSwitch === true && model.occupancySwitch === true && model.occupancySource !== 'ecobee';

comfortSetting.title: Add Comfort Setting
comfortSetting.description: One tile in the Home app with a picker for your ecobee comfort settings (Home, Away, Sleep and your own). Picking one holds it; switching the tile off goes back to your schedule. It is added to the Home app on its own with the bridge's setup code. Restart the bridge after changing this.

comfortHoldType.title: Comfort setting hold
comfortHoldType.description: How long a comfort setting you turn on in the Home app is held.

doorbellCamera.title: Doorbell camera
doorbellCamera.description: Brings the ecobee doorbell into HomeKit Secure Video: recordings, activity zones and Apple's person and package detection in the Home app, plus live view. With the doorbell link it replaces ecobee's doorbell (instant ring and motion). Restart the bridge after changing this. Add it in the Home app with the setup code shown in the Homebridge log. Needs an ffmpeg with libfdk_aac and libx264. See "Doorbell camera" in the README.

motionGrace.title: Motion grace period (seconds)
motionGrace.description: How long a clip keeps recording after motion stops. Someone back in view within this time stays in the same clip.

twoWayAudio.title: Two-way talk
twoWayAudio.description: Talk through the doorbell from the Home app's live view.

twoWayAudioTest.title: Two-way talk test tone
twoWayAudioTest.description: Plays a 3-second tone on the doorbell when live view starts, to check that audio reaches it. Turn it off afterwards.

quickResponses.title: Quick Responses
quickResponses.description: Short messages the doorbell can play. They appear as one Quick Responses tile in the Home app, with a switch per message, which you can add to the live view's Nearby Accessories. Restart the bridge after changing this. See "Quick Responses" in the README.

quickResponseVolume.title: Quick Response volume (%)
quickResponseVolume.description: How loud messages play at the door.

quickResponseMessages.title: Quick Response messages
quickResponseMessages.description: The messages, each with an id that stays the same (it keeps the switch's identity in the Home app), a name of up to 14 characters, and what is said. With no list, the three built-in messages (Leave Delivery, Hang On, Not Home).

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Only for the built-in messages: false removes the switch from the Home app and keeps the wording.

piperPath.title: Piper path
piperPath.description: Only for changed or new wording: the piper program you installed (see "Custom wording with Piper" in the README).

piperVoice.title: Piper voice
piperVoice.description: Path to the voice (.onnx) Piper speaks with.

ffmpegPath.title: ffmpeg path
ffmpegPath.description: Only if the camera can't find ffmpeg. It needs libfdk_aac and libx264. Default: /usr/local/bin/ffmpeg if it exists, else ffmpeg from the PATH.

airQuality.title: Air quality sensors
airQuality.description: Adds 2 sensors for each ecobee Premium thermostat: air quality (with VOC) and CO2. ecobee's own HomeKit integration doesn't include them. Updates every 5 minutes.

co2Alert.title: CO2 alert level (ppm)
co2Alert.description: At or above this level, the CO2 sensor reports abnormal CO2. Use it for notifications and automations, like turning on ventilation.
